info.title: Support Platform
info.description: Dashboard API (/api/admin, cookie session), bot API (/internal, service key) and health checks.

post.description: Step 1 of two-factor sign-in: a new secret to scan in an authenticator app (kept until confirmed).
The code to send to the bot as /link CODE to get notifications in Telegram.

get.description: Global search: ticket number, Telegram ID, @username, name and conversation text.

post.description: A ticket opened by staff for a user (e.g. after a phone call); the first message goes to the user.

get.description: An attachment, only for staff who may see its ticket (or the user's profile for direct messages).
Message history of the user: direct messages and those of tickets the staff member may see.

put.description: Contacts the user gave in the conversation, written down by staff with users.sensitive; audited.

post.description: How many users the segment reaches, shown before sending.
Sends the announcement to the editor's own Telegram.
Sends the draft to the editor's own Telegram (Profile → Telegram notifications must be linked).

put.description: Empty content = the built-in welcome text (translated in Bot texts).
The whole main menu in its order: items are added, removed, renamed, reordered, enabled or disabled.
Saves edited texts of one language; an empty value returns the key to the built-in text.

post.description: A new language: one click for the known ones, or any IETF code with its names.

delete.description: Removes a language from the bot; its translations stay in the content and come back when it is added again.

post.description: A custom status picks a stage, so reports and SLA keep understanding it.

put.description: Response and resolution targets per priority; open tickets get the new targets at once.

post.description: Restart deliveries that are waiting (normally done by the scheduler every minute).
Asks the backup service for a backup now (it checks for requests every minute).

get.description: Everything the bot shows, at one content version: the bot caches it and reloads when the version changes.

post.description: Telegram's id of an uploaded media file: next time the bot sends it without uploading again.
False when this Telegram update was already handled (Telegram retried it): the bot then ignores it.
«Contact support»: the ticket and the user's first message.
A follow-up from the user in their ticket (also reopens a resolved one, see tickets.add_incoming).
/stop and /news: the user's choice about announcements.
The user blocked the bot (my_chat_member update): no more announcements, shown on the profile.
/link CODE from a staff member: their Telegram account gets dashboard notifications.

The user shares their phone (Telegram «share contact», only their own) or types an e-mail, or deletes both.
Nothing is collected without the user acting: a bot never sees these by itself.
What the agent sees before answering in Telegram: the ticket, the user and the last messages.
An agent's answer (or internal note) written in Telegram: stored in the ticket and delivered like a dashboard reply.
